title: Split check_and_enable_services.sh under the 250-line cap with a tested lib/
objective: Bring linux_configuration/scripts/periodic_background/check_and_enable_services.sh from 1225 lines to under the repo-wide 250-line cap by moving its 21 functions into eight sourced libraries beside it, without changing what the tool does on this machine. This is the first of the three safe-tier files in Phase 1 of the 250-cap campaign.
acceptance_criteria: check_and_enable_services.sh and every lib/services_*.sh file is at or under 250 lines; bash meta/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all reports no entry under linux_configuration/scripts/periodic_background/.

meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh against rev 6691cb26 shows every moved function byte-identical after shfmt minification, with check_hosts as the single expected difference because its repair half was deliberately factored into hosts_fix_nsswitch / hosts_fix_resolved / hosts_repair_all.
sudo bash check_and_enable_services.sh --status --dry-run produces output byte-identical to the same command run from a worktree at rev 6691cb26, modulo the Date: line.
shellcheck reports zero findings on the entry script, all eight libs and all four test files, both standalone (as the pre-commit hook runs it, with no -x) and with -x.
shell_coverage.sh reports 100% line coverage for services_common.sh and services_report.sh.
No suppression of any kind is added: no shellcheck disable directive, no noqa, no per-file ignore.
New sourced libs carry a shebang and the executable bit, staged with git add --chmod=+x.
out_of_scope: Fixing the latent status-downgrade bug found in services_units.sh, where an unconditional status="warning" on the is-active check overwrites the status="error" from the is-enabled check, so a timer that is both disabled and inactive is never repaired. It is identical in the pre-split file, it changes live enforcement behaviour, and it belongs in its own commit. The tests pin the current behaviour and name it.

Threading a root-prefix variable through the 29 absolute root-owned paths the check libs probe (/usr/bin/pacman, /etc/hosts, /etc/systemd/system/*.service, ...). That is a rewrite of live enforcement logic, not a line-count fix, and it would forfeit the verbatim-move proof for the other 20 functions.
Reaching 100% coverage on the six libs whose branches are gated by those absolute paths.
The other seven files still over the cap.
verifier: bash meta/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all (no periodic_background entry), bash meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh 6691cb26 <old> <old> <new>... (check_hosts the only diff), the three lib/tests/test_services_*.sh scripts (72 assertions, 0 failures), bash meta/scripts/shell_coverage.sh for services_common.sh and services_report.sh (100.00% each), and a diff of sudo bash check_and_enable_services.sh --status --dry-run against the same command at rev 6691cb26.
